critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: server.py:405 list-comp `[tg.model_dump() for tg in targets]` correctly avoids shadowing the imported pydantic model `Target` (previously `t`). Verified live: /api/targets/generate returns valid targets[].

GOOD: server.py:570-579 `_sysrand = secrets.SystemRandom()` is module-level (single instance, no per-request cost) and exposes .shuffle()+.randint() — drop-in replacement for `random` module. Cryptographically secure; verified scan returns 3-5 signals consistently.

GOOD: routers/payments.py:50 `link = None` defensive init means the `if not link:` guard at line 56 always has a defined name even if `sq.create_payment_link` raises before assignment. The try/except now correctly catches+sanitizes; happy-path returns url+session_id.

GOOD: All 6 test files (test_nexus_backend, v2..v6) read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and DEMO_SESSION_TOKEN from os.environ. v4 has additional fallback that parses /app/frontend/.env if env var unset — robust.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_nexus_v7_regression.py is the canonical regression for the v7 code-quality refactor pass. The 3 critical refactor sites are pinned: (1) TestLeadsScanSecrets validates secrets.SystemRandom shuffle/randint, (2) TestOnboardingAndTargets chains real Claude Sonnet 4.5 call through /api/onboarding → /api/targets/generate → /api/targets to prove the var rename + serialization survives, (3) TestPaymentsCheckoutSession.test_checkout_session_returns_url_and_id is the happy-path proof for the `link = None` defensive init. Onboarding payload requires keys company_name, industry, company_size, icp_description, competitors, value_proposition (NOT value_prop). Targets are returned with field 'company_name' not 'company'. Dashboard metrics response keys: pipeline_value, active_deals, activities_24h, agents_online, avg_deal_cycle_days, revenue_won, weighted_pipeline, targets_identified, win_rate, meetings_booked_week. To run full historical suite: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v` (env var REQUIRED — module-level rstrip() will crash otherwise).
rca of the issue: No app bugs. All 6 critical code-quality refactors are non-regressive: (a) the list-comp var rename (t→tg) preserves the targets[] payload because `model_dump()` operates on the loop var regardless of name; (b) secrets.SystemRandom is a drop-in for random.{shuffle,randint} with identical semantics; (c) `link = None` is harmless defensive init (lint-friendly), the try-raise-except path now safely falls through to the guard; (d) frontend catch blocks now log non-401 errors, improving debuggability without behavior change; (e) stable React keys eliminate hidden reorder bugs without affecting render output; (f) env-driven test config removes secret leakage. The 11 failures in the FULL historical suite are pre-existing test-script drift (missing auth headers, stale mock assertions, stats-key drift) — none caused by the v7 refactor and none reproducible against the live API.
